title: CRISPR Observability: evidence graphs, reusable research laboratory and reproducible analysis

creators.name: Firmenich, Facundo
creators.affiliation: Centro de Estudios del Sur (CEDESUR), Spain and Argentina

description:
Computational software and source-bound evidence for genome-editing observability, finite-record identification and sequence correspondence. The release includes the retained COL17A1 pair ledgers, source spans, target-class witnesses, bounded independent path oracle, executable reproduction entry point and epistemic claim/evidence graph. Historical CFTR/HEK3, K562, HG002, KEAP1 and fragment-linkage evidence is included in the Git tree; one large reference file is preserved as hash-verified reconstructable parts.

Original software: GPL-3.0-only, as selected by the author. Third-party notices and original-study data terms are retained. Manuscript, formal supplementary text and editable manuscript sources are excluded until author-confirmed bioRxiv acceptance. This computational release does not establish independent molecular truth or biological accuracy.

Release 0.8.0 integrates conditional generation-model and locus-block calibration evidence; original extension code is MIT and historical components retain their notices. No manuscript or formal supplement is included.

Version 0.9.0 integrates frozen validation evidence, independent retained-span replay and cross-acquisition germline decision reconstruction through a single offline entry point. Original FASTQ extraction and new ONT/HiFi read scoring are separate upstream analyses.

Version 0.10.0 integrates the epistemic Supergraph, Read Observability Lab, multi-input v0.5 engine with CLI/API/MCP, an authentic two-read CFTR leading case, English/Spanish researcher documentation, Streamlit and Docker access, and native platform launchers. Three programme research lines have documented, distinct integration states; independent community adoption is not asserted.
